meta.description: The latest posts and news about Disscount.

disscount-launch.title: Disscount is live! Thank you, beta testers
disscount-launch.excerpt: We're inviting around 200 people from the waitlist to try Disscount first.

body.p1: The big day is here: Disscount is officially live! To start, we're inviting around 200 people from our waitlist to try the app first and help us make it even better.
body.p2: Thank you for your patience and for backing us from day one. This is only the beginning, and we're glad to be starting it with you.

whats-next.title: What comes after launch
whats-next.excerpt: We're working on new features, from a store map to spending tracking. Your suggestions shape what we build next.

body.p1: In the coming weeks we're working on new features: an interactive store map with opening hours, an overview of your own spending, and digital loyalty cards.
body.p2: Your opinion matters most to us: on the Ideas and suggestions page you can suggest new features and vote for the ones you want to see first.
